articles.title: Asian refiners in dispute with Saudis over 2027 oil contracts
articles.excerpt:
Saudi Aramco’s term-contract negotiations with Asian oil refiners have run into trouble due to disagreements over outstanding purchases in existing deals, said traders involved in the discussions.

The disputes are a byproduct of the West Asia war, which cut exports from the region and meant that Saudi Arabia’s customers weren’t able to collect their contracted supply. That forced refiners to switch to a more opportunistic mode of buying Persian Gulf oil via the spot market.

To satisfy this demand, Aramco ramped up spot sales to Asia from early September, taking advantage of a recovery in flows through the Strait of Hormuz even as attacks on ships continued.
